normalization_plan.reason: the deposit amount parameter only feeds the share minting inside _deposit
the share parameter is only consumed by _withdraw when burning shares
the option terms parameter is only used by _setNextOption validation
the newCap parameter is only written into the cap variable by setCap
the vault parameter is only used by withdrawToV1Vault for the destination deposit
the order parameter is only forwarded by sellOptions to the Swap contract
the local withdrawAmount is only consumed by the raw ETH transfer
the local feeAmount is only consumed by the external fee transfer
the local shortAmount is only consumed by the adapter delegatecall
the local newOption is only assigned to currentOption inside rollToNextOption
the local balance snapshot is only used in the internal share math
the local oldOption is only used inside _closeShort to close the position
